states.placement: do-nothing: released subcomponents, delta-W in Delta, Gamma frozen
states.position: the key position half = 20 of the held-out windows

sets.S: alive subcomponents whose mean importance at the key position over the training windows rises by more than 0.3 (recruit.switched(regating.shift_of(...), 0.3))
sets.gold: the |S| alive subcomponents of largest W0 contrast at Pile val rows 0-2000 positions whose next token is one of the table's 32 values (recruit.ContrastAcc, signatures.top_by)
sets.D: E38 Amendment 5: per matrix, the |S in k| alive subcomponents outside S of largest training-window e_c (recruitment.top_per_matrix)

rules.gap: for X in (every_alive, S), seed s: gap = min over copy tables of rho_X - max over random-map tables of rho_X; separates if gap >= 0.3 on both seeds; reversed if max(copy) - min(random) <= -0.3 on both seeds; unscored if either seed has a state unscored for X; else does not separate
rules.unscored_state: every X when G < 1 nat; X when rho_X is not finite; S also when |S| = 0 or the random sets' max rho > 0.15
rules.reading: first match: conflict (one of every_alive, S separates and the other is reversed); separates; toys unreadable (every_alive scored and <= 0.2 on all eight states); reversed; unscored (every_alive unscored); does not separate
rules.reported_only: gold, D, the random means and the stand-in ratio against 'expected'; they change no verdict

noise_floor: one restore under bf16 ~0.02 nats (E38 Amendment 3 R4b), ~0.0015 of G; E38 seed spread on rho(S), rho(every_alive) <= 0.035; the random draws' sd per state is reported
stop_rules: an E46 window or state file missing or not its recorded sha256: exit before any reading
controls C1, C2, R0, R1, R2 on all eight states before any share; any miss: results written, FAIL logged, exit 1
results JSON rewritten after each state; every scored number printed to the log
G < 1 nat is not a stop: that state is unscored
